name: Goulburn Valley Internet Services
summary: Regional Victoria ISP in the Goulburn Valley (Shepparton VIC). Four 1997 IP-index allocations (GOULBURNVALLEYI1-AU .. GOULBURNVALLEYI4-AU, 203.36.124/124/144/191). Distinct from Goulburn Internet (NSW).

events.details: Existing by 1997: GOULBURNVALLEYI1-AU (203.36.124.0/26), GOULBURNVALLEYI2-AU (203.36.124.64/26), GOULBURNVALLEYI3-AU (203.36.144.0/24), GOULBURNVALLEYI4-AU (203.36.191.0/24) - Shepparton VIC. NOTE: distinct from Goulburn Internet (goulburn-internet, NSW).

Possibly related: 'G. V. I. Pty Ltd' / GVI Unit Trust (ABN 63 673 479 916), VIC 3630 (Shepparton), active Jul-Nov 2002, cancelled - likely an investment vehicle of the Goulburn Valley Internet operation, but the trading name is 'GVI Unit Trust' and identity as the ISP is unconfirmed.
